results.rationale: Consistency: The right cup, coffee-bean arrangements, both saucers, white background and shadows remain visually unchanged. Instruction: No meaningful enlargement of the left cup is visible; a successful edit would make it match the right cup, but it remains substantially smaller. Quality: Structure, natural lighting, artifact absence and texture fidelity are satisfactory; the ceramic rims and individual beans are coherent.

Consistency: Excluding the requested fur-color change, the hamster’s pose, eyes, ears, nose, whiskers, bedding, blue backdrop and bark retain their appearance and placement. Instruction: The fur has a slightly cooler, grayer appearance around the face and chest, but the head and body remain predominantly cream and tan; the expected gray hamster is mostly unrealized. Quality: Structure, naturalness, artifact absence and texture fidelity are satisfactory, with coherent anatomy, fine fur and whiskers, and plausible bedding and bark.
